name: Product Feedback
description: Feedback on a product or feature: what works, what hurts, and requests.
outline: Name the product or feature the feedback is about.
List what works well, each as a short bullet.
List problems, frustrations and bugs, with how severe the speaker made them sound.
List feature requests separately, worded as the need rather than the solution.
Quote one or two representative lines exactly.
Keep it factual: never add information that is not in the transcript, and omit a section when nothing applies.
example:
## Problems
- Export fails on large files (blocking)

## Requests
- Dark mode for night use
